label: Ability kinds
description: How an ability is triggered. 'Uses a key' kinds count toward the tier's key budget.

terms.label: Active
terms.description: Press to use. It may have a cooldown, a cost per use, or neither.

terms.label: Toggle / mode switch
terms.description: Switches between two modes, such as two weapons.

terms.label: Deploy
terms.description: Becomes stationary to gain a stronger mode.

terms.label: Channel
terms.description: Hold to keep it going; ends on release, interruption or when its resource runs out.

terms.label: Ultimate
terms.description: Charges up over time or through play.

terms.label: Triggered
terms.description: Happens on an event: on a kill, on death, when hit.

tie_breaks.rule: Pick deploy when the unit cannot move at all in one of the two states: it has to stop and set up. Pick toggle when it can move in both, even if it is slow or cannot fire while moving in one of them.

Pick channel when the source says you hold the key to keep the effect going (press and hold to burn a boost, to keep a beam or a shield up), or that it stops as soon as you let go, move or are interrupted. Holding a key to aim or charge and releasing it to act is not channel: the effect starts on release. A timed action that runs to its end on its own is active.

Ultimate when the source says the button must be charged before each use, through play (kills, damage dealt or taken) or by a charge meter of its own, even when it also has a cooldown; band that cooldown as given. Active when only a cooldown or a stock holds it back.

Pick triggered when each event causes a one-off effect, such as taking a weapon on a kill or exploding on death. Pick passive when the effect is always on, including bonuses that build up from events and then stay, such as ranks.
